name: Item Consolidation
description: Retire duplicate items without merging them: stock is repacked into the item to keep (posted now, so nothing is reposted into closed periods), masters and BOMs are pointed at it, and the old item is disabled.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Stock of the retired items is moved in this company's warehouses.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Queued
In Progress
Completed
Partly Failed
Failed

fields.label: Copy Masters
fields.description: Item Prices, reorder levels, supplier/customer item codes, Product Bundles and Pricing Rules - only what the item to keep is missing.

fields.label: Replace in BOMs
fields.description: Swap the component in every active or draft BOM (submitted BOMs are edited in place, as with the BOM Update Tool's Replace Component Item).

fields.label: Update BOM Costs Afterwards
fields.description: Queue the BOM Update Tool's Update Cost for all BOMs so parent BOMs pick up the change.

fields.label: Disable Retired Items
fields.description: Disable each retired item and note which item replaced it. Requires that no open documents still use it.

fields.label: Disable Even With Open Documents
fields.description: Disable the retired items even though open documents still use them. Those documents will then fail on submit until they are amended to the kept item. Offered on Submit when open documents are the only blocker.
